title: Instareadr

sources.review: Read all 13 slides and exposed speaker notes through HTML presentation using the authorised Sayyid Chrome profile; visually inspected technology-flow slide.

evidence: Long Web3 white papers are difficult to digest; shorten them into 5–10 visual cards.
Generative AI ingests, simplifies and prepares infographic-ready content.
Quiz-based reinforcement and NFT certification are goals, not verified shipped functionality.
Reading and commenting increase engagement levels; rewards are proposed for milestones.
Proposed stack: Next.js, React and ICP storage; token gating and article tokenisation are proposed revenue streams.
interpretation: Explicit three-stage pipeline: source book, AI chip labelled Digest / Distil / Simplify, then phone with ten numbered lesson sections and a separate alternative video panel. Video is user-directed concept expansion, not a verified feature from the 2023 deck.
animation: 40-second loop: source ingestion 1–5s, AI processing 5–10s, ten sections revealed 10–17s, reading 17–27s, alternative video 27–36s, fade/reset 38–40s.
refinement: Approved 2D artwork retained. 3D chamber rebuilt with transparent glass, machined ring fittings, bolts, internal circuitry and luminous particles; smaller AI chip allows the chamber to remain visible. Source stack enlarged. Ten output tiles now have varied miniature illustrations. Separate video stand beside phone avoids covering the sections.
userClarification: Large information passes through AI, distilled into ten Instagram-style learning sections OR one video.
